project.type: static learning portal (GitHub Pages, no backend)

inputs_required_at_build_time.GITHUB_OWNER: supplied by the user in the Claude Code session
inputs_required_at_build_time.REPO_NAME: supplied by the user in the Claude Code session
inputs_required_at_build_time.rule: Never hard-code or guess. Inspect git remote and confirm with the user before pushing. Derive SITE_URL and BASE_PATH from them.

objectives: Develop the learner into an enterprise AI Solution Architect with SAP CX specialisation
Teach architectural judgment through real-world cases with explicit provenance
Assess real understanding (scenario-weighted) and adapt the pathway
Keep all progress local with portable JSON backup
Work with no backend and no API keys

background: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, tool calling, MCP
constraints: Cannot rely on installing Python or dev environments on personal or office laptops
Some OpenAI credits; portal must not depend on them

content_package.counts_policy: Never hard-code content counts in UI or docs; compute from data.
content_package.partial_content_policy: App must run with partial content and show honest empty states; never generate filler content.

acceptance_criteria.text: With no data the dashboard routes to the assessment invitation, not an empty chart.
Every recommendation displays "Because ..." text derived from the scoring factors in section 8.4.
Level, gates and counts are computed from data, not hard-coded.
Works at 360 px width without horizontal scrolling.
Score contributions use the weights above; a unit test with a fixed answer set reproduces expected competency estimates.
Refreshing mid-assessment resumes at the same question.
Self-assessment never raises a mastery state; it only alters calibration and order of sampling.
Results page lists strengths, gaps, overconfident and underconfident competencies, and the reasons topics were compressed or deepened.
Retaking is allowed; history of assessment runs is preserved.
If the question bank has fewer items than the target for a competency, the assessment still runs and reports "low evidence" for that competency.
A topic is never listed before its prerequisites unless the learner overrides.
Proficient topics appear compressed with a "confirm in 2 questions" step.
No calendar dates anywhere in the pathway view. [REQ]
Build-time validation fails on cycles or dangling prerequisites.
Filters combine (AND) and persist in the URL query string.
Every topic page shows prerequisites with live state and "next topics unlocked".
Marking a lesson read records a `lessonViewed` event only; it does not change mastery. [REQ]
Depth switch is instant and remembered per topic.
If lesson body is absent (content phase not done), the page shows objectives, resources and questions and a clear "lesson text not written yet" banner, never filler text.
Every V claim shows at least one source ID resolvable on `/sources/`.
V, I, R, U use distinct labels and colours plus text/icon (not colour alone).
Build fails if a case lacks sources, a V fact cites a source not in its source list, or a Tier A case has fewer than 3 decisions.
Simulations render with a persistent "SIMULATION" badge and are listed in a separate collection.
The library shows true counts by tier and states when the catalog is smaller than any aspirational figure.
Diagrams reconstructed by Claude Code from text are labelled "Reconstructed"; source diagrams are linked, not copied.
Each diagram has alt text; each reconstructed one carries the label.
Diagrams reflow or scroll within a container on mobile without breaking layout.

functional_requirements.title: Assessment engine (shared by F02, quizzes, exercises)

acceptance_criteria.text: Options are shuffled with a seeded shuffle recorded in the attempt.
Explanations show after submission, with links back to topic and case.
Each attempt stores timestamp, item id, content version, response, score, confidence rating (1-5), time spent.
Every question must map to at least one topic and competency (build-time check).
Mastery logic matches section 8 and is covered by unit tests.
A topic cannot be proficient or mastered with zero applied-item evidence.
Later failed case exercises reduce related topic estimates and can reopen a topic (state regression allowed) and queue revision.
Resources with `to_verify` status render a "link not yet verified" label.
A build-time link-check script reports external URL failures as warnings and writes a report; it never silently drops resources.
Paid resources are labelled.
Intervals and penalties come from configuration.
Queue persists across sessions; overdue items accumulate without penalty text.
The learner can reset or snooze a card.
Deterministic given the same data and config (seeded tie-break).
Recommendation includes mix balance (learn, case, exercise, revise) and explains when balance shifted.
When prerequisites for a chosen case are in gap, the recommendation is the prerequisite topic with "then return to case X".
Index built in CI; search works under the base path.
No query leaves the browser.
Each of the six sample questions is answerable in two interactions or fewer.
Graph view degrades to list when JavaScript graph rendering is unavailable.
Graph data generated at build time from validated content.
Streak never blocks or scolds; missed days display no penalty.
Level changes only from gate evidence.
Reload preserves state.
Simulated storage failure (test) triggers session-only banner, no crash.
Schema migration framework exists with at least a tested v1→v2 stub.
When content IDs are removed or renamed, orphaned records are retained, flagged, and excluded from active metrics, never deleted silently.
Round-trip test: export, wipe, import reproduces identical derived state.
Malformed, truncated or wrong-schema files are rejected with a specific message and change nothing.
Merge test with two diverging exports yields union of attempts and no duplicate attempt ids.
Backup reminder logic per F01.
Items marked `verify` display a visible "verify before use" marker on the topic or case page that cites them.
ADR export produces valid Markdown with decision, options, criteria, trade-offs.

cross_cutting_acceptance_criteria.text: axe reports zero serious or critical violations on every route type in CI.
Full assessment completable by keyboard only.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: LCP <= 2.5 s on throttled mobile for key pages; initial JS <= 120 KB gzip on content pages; page weight <= 500 KB excluding video; Lighthouse performance >= 90 and accessibility >= 95 on sampled routes
WCAG 2.2 AA target; keyboard-operable; axe zero serious/critical on every route type; reduced motion respected; no colour-only meaning
Works at 360, 768, 1100, 1440 px; no horizontal page scroll at 360; touch targets >= 44 px
No secrets in repo, bundle, config or Git history; secret scan in CI and pre-commit; strict CSP meta; rel noopener; imported JSON validated, size-limited, never evaluated; Markdown sanitised
No data leaves the browser; no third-party analytics; video embeds click-to-load via privacy-enhanced domain
Storage failure degrades to session-only mode with warning; error boundaries per island; import is non-destructive on failure
Content separate from logic; schema-validated content; engine fully unit-tested; ADRs for key decisions; minimal pinned dependencies
Latest two versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (desktop and mobile); GitHub Pages project-site base path supported
Provenance tags V/I/R/U enforced by build; no fabricated facts, metrics, diagrams or resources; unverified items visibly labelled
Library growth to hundreds of cases and thousands of questions without code changes; per-route code splitting; search index built in CI

evidence_tags.R: Reconstructed: inferred to fill gaps (none used in batch 1)

tier_definitions.A: Full walkthrough candidate: builder-authored technical primary source
tier_definitions.A-provisional: Primary source identified; full body not yet read
tier_definitions.B: Structured analysis: limited depth or implementer-authored
tier_definitions.C: Catalog stub: marketing, editorial or secondary; no invented detail

walkthrough_sections: Why selected approach may be preferable
case_content_schema.render_rule: Render only sections that exist in data; never fabricate missing sections

compress.when: Initial or later assessment shows proficient on this topic's competencies
compress.content: One-page summary, key terms, 2 confirmation questions, jump to related cases

standard.content: Guided lesson, curated resources with focus notes, worked example, quiz, one exercise

deep.content: Prerequisite refresh, extended lesson, multiple examples, scaffolded exercises, targeted re-assessment

summary: Spaced revision intervals scheduling reviews only

progress_tracking_model.derived: topicState and competency estimates recomputable from attempts

ui_ux.direction: serious professional workbench, subtle gamification, no childish elements
ui_ux.navigation: Dashboard, Pathway, Curriculum, Cases, Review, Map, Progress; utility Search and Settings; mobile bottom bar plus More

design_system.typography: self-hosted variable fonts, font-display swap, no external font CDN
design_system.provenance_encoding: colour plus icon plus text label

technical_architecture.content: Astro content collections with Zod validation from JSON and Markdown
technical_architecture.interactivity: Preact or React islands (assessment, dashboard, map)
technical_architecture.diagrams: Mermaid prerendered to SVG at build; text alternatives required
technical_architecture.styling: CSS with tokens (Tailwind acceptable; record ADR)
technical_architecture.deviation_rule: Any deviation from the recommended stack requires an ADR explaining why and the impact on requirements

data_persistence.secondary: localStorage for small UI preferences only, with try/catch and in-memory fallback
data_persistence.orphan_policy: retain, flag, exclude from active metrics

backup.merge_rule: union of attempts by id; latest timestamp wins for mutable records

data_persistence.user_notice: Data lives only in this browser profile on this device; clearing site data or changing device loses it unless a backup is imported; no automatic sync.

security_requirements: No API keys, secrets or tokens anywhere in repo, bundle, config or Git history
BYO-key practical exercises are documentation only and explain cost and key-handling
Secret scanning in CI and pre-commit

rules: All internal URLs via one base-aware helper
Static HTML per route so refresh on deep links works
Check current versions of GitHub Actions before pinning
Post-deploy smoke test of home and one deep link

integration: content validators with broken fixtures: cycle, dangling id, missing source, V fact with unlisted source, Tier A with fewer than 3 decisions
e2e: UJ-01..UJ-10 under the real base path
testing_requirements.reporting_rule: Report exactly which tests ran and their results; never claim unexecuted coverage

documentation_requirements: CONTENT_GUIDE incl. case research protocol and tiering
deployment_guide_requirements: Exact repository settings path: Settings > Pages
Use GitHub Actions as source and why
What options to select and save

Troubleshooting: 404, blank page or missing CSS (wrong base), Actions permission errors, Pages not enabled, build validation failures, environment protection rules, path case sensitivity, cache delays
How to update later and how to roll back
How to back up progress before updates
out_of_scope: In-portal LLM calls or API keys
assumptions: Stack choice is a recommendation (ADR if changed)
Engine thresholds and weights are tunable defaults
Content arrives in phases; app handles partial content
SAP availability and pricing facts conflict across sources and are time-sensitive
Regulatory content is educational, not legal advice

Curate and link-check in content phase; status to_verify until checked
